notes.deciding_text: 6212 Brassières, girdles, corsets, braces, suspenders, garters and similar articles and parts thereof, whether or not knitted or crocheted. 6212 10 Brassières: Brassieres of all types of textile materials, whether or not elasticated, incl. knitted or crocheted.

notes.deciding_text: 9619 Sanitary towels (pads) and tampons, napkins (diapers), napkin liners and similar articles, of any material.
6307 Other made-up articles, including dress patterns. 6307 90 Other: Made-up articles of textile materials, incl. dress patterns, n.e.s.

This heading does not include: (c) articles which, on account of their design, are intended exclusively for animals (for example, fabric 'mice' containing cat-mint, buffalo hide shoes 'for chewing', plastic bones). See also note 5 to this chapter.
notes.oj: OJ C 119, 29.3.2019, p. 1 (Explanatory Notes to the CN, note to heading 9503)
